programs.sub_title: Dreams, Teens, and Tight Spaces in Amsterdam
programs.desc: A history-buff dad chases a long-delayed university dream and moves his family to Amsterdam. They're looking for a place comfortable enough for their three teenage boys, but finding everything on their wish list may come with a heavy price.

programs.title: House Hunters International
programs.sub_title: Something for Mom: Italy and France
programs.desc: A mother's love is unconditional, and these travelers are heading to Italy and France in hopes of showing their gratitude. But adjusting to a new country isn't easy, especially when their real focus is finding the perfect gift for Mom.

programs.title: House Hunters International
programs.sub_title: A Family Fight in Mexico's Yucatán
programs.desc: A family gives up their semi-nomadic life of travel to plant roots in Mexico's Yucatán. He dreams of a quiet beach life while mom and daughter prefer to be closer to the city, so they may struggle to find a place where no one has to settle.

programs.title: House Hunters International
programs.sub_title: Feeling the Noise in Phnom Penh
programs.desc: A young Portuguese couple look to advance their careers, education and relationship in Phnom Penh, Cambodia; he doesn't mind spending more to get a place with a pool, but she prefers to stay under budget and find something that's near her work.

programs.title: House Hunters International
programs.sub_title: My House, My Rules in Lisbon
programs.desc: A recently graduated New Hampshire woman who grew up traveling with her family has decided to make the move to Lisbon, Portugal; her mom isnt exactly thrilled, so shes along in the search to help find a space big enough for frequent family visits.
